notes:
### Screenshot Capture Reliability

- Keep high-resolution 1024x576 Dorcel frozen-frame captures and recover from isolated invalid captures instead of permanently disabling the feature after a single ValueError.
- Log specific capture rejection and retry reasons; retain a previously validated frame only while it is fresh and belongs to the current session.
- Fall back to the black recovery curtain whenever no valid current frame is available.

### PVR Restart Detection

- Detect recent IPTV Simple Client recreation in the Kodi log when a stopped-player callback occurs during One Channel tests.
- Treat a corroborated internal PVR recreation as a recoverable playback interruption rather than a manual user Stop.
- Keep explicit manual Stop behavior as Save Log Only without Suspend/Shutdown, and log when user input cannot be independently verified.

### Popup Labels & Timing

- Restore user-facing "1h" and "2h" wording on the extension buttons, while retaining 65/125-minute internal verification cutoffs and prompts at 62:30/122:30.
- Preserve the modal two-button interaction and 60-second timeout for 1h/2h checks; the 30-minute prompt continues at minute 25.
- The 15-minute check does not offer a follow-on extension prompt. Start from 30 minutes to exercise the complete 30m -> 1h -> 2h -> Unlimited path.

### Compatibility and Testing

- Preserve existing Dorcel five-minute SOURCE_WINDOW behavior, signed stream expiry handling, PVR_COM/PVR_COM_SITE routing, HLS live delay, guarded restarts and diagnostic safeguards.
- Offline checks cannot prove Kodi user input, HDMI overlay quality or uninterrupted playback; validate on LibreELEC before considering this a final stable release.
